subject: Novus Health - implementation handoff and kickoff planning
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ryan Carter <ryan.carter@novushealth.com>, Novus Health Procurement <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Novus Health - handoff & initial implementation notes

Monica / Tessa,

Quick handoff from the deal side — Novus signed last week (ND-202711-034). High-level context and immediate risks so CS can pick this up cleanly:

1) Scope & timeline
- Initial scope: embeddings for patient-data search, chat assistant for clinicians (limited to de-identified notes), and per-route rate caps.
- Target pilot/go-live: 2028-01-31 with a 4-week pilot starting 2028-01-03.

2) Commercials & procurement
- PO expected to land next week; procurement looped. Pricing and discounts finalized in HubSpot deal notes.

3) Security / compliance items (blocking):
- Novus requires SOC 2 Type II evidence and an entry-level data-residency attestation (US-only). SOC2 report is scheduled to be uploaded to the shared drive by evening Nov 30 — I attached the draft SOW and network reqs.

4) Technical contacts and access
- Primary Novus technical: Ryan Carter (ryan.carter@novushealth.com)
- Novus infra contact (procurement CC) will need the requirements sheet for firewall/IP allowlist.

5) Risk notes from sales
- They plan to run a small subset of PHI-like records (de-identified) in the pilot; we should validate our PHI-safe guidance with Security.
- They asked explicitly for a 99th percentile latency SLO because clinician workflows are latency-sensitive.

Immediate asks for CS:
- Assign primary steward for Novus pilot and provide a 2-week onboarding cadence (kickoff, technical intake, security sign-off, pilot ops).
- Confirm that we can meet their latency expectation on the model family proposed or propose an equivalent variant.

Attachments: Novus_SOW_v1.pdf, network_requirements.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync if helpful.

-karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ryan Carter <ryan.carter@novushealth.com>, Novus Health Procurement <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novus Health - handoff & initial implementation notes

Thanks Karthik — good summary.

Ryan — great to meet you (virtually). Welcome aboard. We (CS) will take the lead on coordination and technical intake. Proposed next steps:

1) Kickoff window: Thu Dec 2 or Mon Dec 6 (30–45 min) — please let me know which works for your team and who should be on the call (tech + procurement).
2) Pre-kickoff ask: procurement, can you confirm the procurement contact for PO + any special contract terms?
3) Triage: Tessa, please review the attached SOW and network reqs and flag any immediate questions.

Karthik, can you also paste the HubSpot deal link and the list of approved model variants (we agreed on a quantized 7B family for latency economics)?

I will create the project in our onboarding tracker and assign owners after the kickoff.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Ryan Carter <ryan.carter@novushealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Novus Health Procurement <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novus Health - handoff & initial implementation notes

Monica / Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround. Thu Dec 2 is best for us, 10:00–10:45 PT. I will have our infrastructure lead (Maya Singh) + procurement (attached in CC) on the call.

A couple of items to call out from our side:
- We will require the security questionnaire before the kickoff if possible (we'll do a preliminary review).
- On data handling: the clinical team will submit de-identified records but procurement wants confirmation on log retention policies and request flow (who sees request metadata).

I reviewed the SOW and have a few small edits (attachment: redlines). If you can share a Milestone / Acceptance criteria doc ahead of the call, that would be helpful.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Ryan Carter
Head of Digital Products
Novus Health
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 16:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novus Health - handoff & initial implementation notes

Triage notes and owner assignment (internal):

- Primary CS Owner: Tessa Morgan — lead on kickoff, technical intake, pilot cadence, runbook creation.
- Backup Owner / Ops escalation: Stephanie Nguyen — will cover security questionnaires and procurement coordination.
- Sales escalation: Karthik will remain on-thread for commercial / contract questions.

Action items I assigned in the onboarding tracker (link below):
- Create project workspace + kickoff agenda (Tessa) — due EOD Thu Dec 2 (so we can share before the meeting).
- Pull SOC2 extract and retention policy snippet for procurement (Stephanie) — due Wed Dec 8.
- Confirm model variant and expected 99p latency with Performance (Karthik & Tessa) — initial check-in Tue Dec 7.

Attachments added to project: redwood_onboard_runbook.md (high-level tasks), SOW v1, network_requirements.xlsx
HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/ND-202711-034
Onboarding tracker: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/novus/onboarding/technical-intake

Tessa / Stephanie — please confirm you accept these assignments and update the tracker. I'll introduce you to Maya / Ryan on the kickoff.

Thanks — Monica
